instruction: A candid romantic close-up photograph of a couple kissing outdoors in a sunny field. On the right, the woman with long brown hair (R1) in a denim jacket leans in to kiss her partner. On the left, the man with short dark hair (R2), also in a denim jacket, holds her close. The woman wraps her hand around the back of the man's neck. The background shows softly blurred trees under warm, bright sunlight that creates a gentle rim light on their hair.

R2 holds R1 close during the kiss
R1 wraps her hand around the back of R2's neck
R1 and R2 are in a close romantic kissing pose
